mechanism_narrative: A higher-than-trend FEDFUNDS rate at month-end precedes a 20-day S&P 500 forward return decline due to expectations of tighter policy.
failure_condition: Over 12 consecutive months with FEDFUNDS above average, 20-day forward returns are non-negative in all instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength boosts investor confidence.
failure_condition: In regimes with PAYEMS below average for 6 months, 60-day forward returns remain negative despite rising employment.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in HOUST (retail sales) followed by a 5-day positive S&P 500 forward return reflects immediate demand-driven equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: Over 8 consecutive weeks of above-trend HOUST, no positive 5-day forward returns occur.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) predicts a 20-day S&P 500 forward return drop as weak supply signals weak economic momentum.
failure_condition: INDPRO shows no downward trend for 6 months; 20-day forward returns remain non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) over the next 60 days is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return via dual demand channels.
failure_condition: In 60-day windows where GDPC1 and RSAFS are both below their 12-month averages, forward returns are not statistically positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (unemployment) over 3 months triggers a 20-day S&P 500 forward return positive as lower labor costs encourage equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 3-month average for 4 consecutive quarters; 20-day forward returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS exceeds a 5% monthly increase for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a 60-day forward return up, reflecting strong hiring momentum.
failure_condition: No 60-day window with two consecutive months of >5% PAYEMS growth shows positive forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 simultaneously predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to dual supply-side weakness.
failure_condition: Over 12 months with no simultaneous INDPRO and GDPC1 declines, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative.
